services.name: Motta Charters
services.desc: This report covers a total of 5 “official” trips in May. The season is off to a great start with a total of over 840 fish caught in just 5 trips. We’ve caught over 30 Slot Stripers in May, only keeping 8 of them! The Sea Bass fishing officially started May 21st. and has been consistent with all trips yielding 4 fish limits for all our guests onboard. The Scup bite is off the charts and they are BIG! We’ve landed several in the 15 to 17 inch range with plenty of double hook-ups. The Tog bite was good but we started late this year not going at all in April.
